maria: FYI bringing up Harpoon LoRA merge on int4. Quick smoke showed entity recall drop vs baseline (orig-model+LoRA).

devin: where's the eval pack? can you paste top-level metrics?

maria: quickpack link: https://internal/quickpacks/harpoon/4
maria: key numbers: baseline F1 0.82 -> merged 0.73 on cust-entity set; perplexity unchanged. Throughput g4dn x2.

ashok: ugh 0.09 F1 delta is big. Did we run tokenizer mapping? LoRA trained on new vocab?

eva: ran tokenizer check: token alignment ok. suspect quantization + merge interplay. did you test float16 vs int4?

maria: tested hf-16 vs q4_0. float16 merged = 0.818, q4_0 merged = 0.73. so int4 is killing it.

samir: can you paste the small eval snippet?

maria: ```
GET /evals/harpoon/quick
metrics:
  entity_f1: {baseline: 0.82, merged_fp16: 0.818, merged_q4: 0.73}
  exact_match: {baseline: 0.61, merged_q4: 0.53}
  lat_p50: 42ms
```

devin: CI bot triggered a batch smoke with cache disabled: @ci-bot what's the job link?

ci-bot: job https://ci/harpoon/867 ran: 2024-09-05T14:22Z. result: failed (regressions detected). See artifact: /artifacts/harpoon/q4-diff.json

ashok: plan: 1) reproduce locally with int4 + disable prefix cache 2) try per-layer fp16 for attention kernels 3) if still bad, fallback to q8_0 for customer rollouts
